title: Smart Sun Protection
desc: Use a broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen and reapply every 2–3 hours for full protection outdoors.

title: Hydration Matters
desc: Drink water consistently throughout the day to stay energized and prevent heat exhaustion.

title: UV Eye Safety
desc: Protect your eyes with UV-blocking sunglasses to reduce long-term sun damage.

title: Light Summer Wear
desc: Choose breathable, light-colored clothing to stay cool and comfortable in hot weather.

title: Apply Sunscreen Daily
desc: Use SPF 30+ every morning and reapply every 2 hours when outdoors.

title: Stay Hydrated
desc: Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily. More if you're out in the sun!

title: Protect Your Eyes
desc: Wear UV-protection sunglasses to shield your eyes from harmful rays.

title: Cover Up
desc: Wear a wide-brim hat and light clothing to reduce direct sun exposure.
